about: The drill-type rig-look parts (ticket 622, wave 308-1B of spec #308): one asset at the drill_tip track's attach slot (#578's slot and frame), one look per owned drill-gear item, so a fitted type wins the slot over the drill_tip look step (HS rule on #576). The wiring (#623) names the looks from owned state through the rig-look registry (#577), never from here; this is the table the author script, the reach check and the review renders share. A look is one or more parts: a moving part has its origin at its hinge or slide and carries a folded and a deployed pose (a turn in radians, counter-clockwise on screen, and a shift in metres), as techGear.json's rows do, so a toggled-off cutter can fold in and the boom can retract. Parts are authored at the deployed pose.
